title: Powerus (Nasdaq: PUSA) CEO to Keynote Solana Breakpoint Following Backpack’s Launch of $PUSA Token
summary: Dominari Securities is dedicated to helping clients preserve, grow and create new wealth by providing a full range investment advisory and wealth planning services.
body_markdown:
Fox will discuss what it means for a Nasdaq-listed U.S. defense company to have tokens backed by its shares trade on a public blockchain


﻿


- Andrew Fox, Chief Executive Officer of Powerus, will deliver a keynote at Solana Breakpoint 2026, held November 15 to 17 at Olympia London


- Breakpoint 2026 is the first Breakpoint held in the United Kingdom


- Fox will speak about the $PUSA token on Solana and what it means for a Nasdaq-listed U.S. defense company to have tokens backed by its shares trade on a public blockchain


ROCK HILL, S.C.--(


[BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/) )--Powerus Corporation (Nasdaq: PUSA), a U.S. defense technology company focused on autonomous and unmanned systems, today announced that Chief Executive Officer Andrew Fox will deliver a keynote at Solana Breakpoint 2026, the Solana Foundation’s annual conference, held November 15 to 17 at Olympia London. It is the first Breakpoint held in the United Kingdom.


Fox’s keynote, “Why We Went Onchain”, will take place on November 16th at 4:30PM GMT. He will speak about the $PUSA token on Solana and what it means for a Nasdaq-listed U.S. defense company to have tokens backed by its shares trade on a public blockchain.


The $PUSA token was made available on Solana through Sunrise on October 2, 2026, the day after Powerus completed its merger. The token was issued by an affiliate of Backpack Securities, not by Powerus.


Additional information about the token, including who issues and controls it, appears under “About Tokenized PUSA” below.


“Tokenization is changing how investors can hold public company shares, and a defense company is not where most people expect that conversation to start. At Breakpoint, I want to talk openly about what it means for a Nasdaq-listed company like Powerus, including how investors are protected and which questions are still open,” said Andrew Fox, Chief Executive Officer of Powerus.


“Tokenized equities have to be backed one to one and built on regulated infrastructure to earn investors’ trust. We’re glad Andrew is bringing a public company’s perspective to that conversation at Breakpoint,” said Armani Ferrante, Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Backpack.


**About Powerus**


Powerus Corporation (formerly Aureus Greenway Holdings Inc., Nasdaq: PUSA) builds and scales unified autonomous systems designed to move, protect, and sustain critical assets in high-risk environments, with capabilities spanning heavy-lift platforms, autonomous air systems, autonomous maritime systems, mission systems, training and support, and U.S.-based manufacturing. Powerus Corporation also owns and manages two golf courses in the Orlando, Florida region. On October 1, 2026, Powerus completed its previously announced merger with AGH; shares continue trading on Nasdaq under the symbol PUSA. Learn more at


[power.us](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.power.us&esheet=54642016&newsitemid=20261116063964&lan=en-US&anchor=power.us&index=3&md5=b9fd0c2ad0c07c8d259ba2393501bee7) .


**About Tokenized PUSA**


The $PUSA token is issued by Trek Nexus Markets Ltd, a British Virgin Islands affiliate of Backpack Securities (the “issuer”), and was made available on Solana through Sunrise on October 2, 2026. Powerus did not issue, sponsor, or launch the token and received no proceeds from it. According to Backpack, each token is a depositary receipt redeemable 1:1, by holders who complete Backpack Securities’ onboarding requirements, for a security entitlement to one share of Powerus common stock held by the issuer. Backpack affiliates retain mint, freeze, and blacklist authority over the token. Token holder rights, including any voting or dividend rights, are set by the issuer’s terms and may differ from the rights of a registered holder of Powerus common stock. Powerus does not operate, control, or endorse any platform on which the token trades. According to Backpack, the token is offered only to eligible investors in certain jurisdictions. Investors should review the issuer’s disclosures before acquiring the token.
